qualification.correctness_scope: first occurrence of each default bucket plus final step; all private outputs, three occurrence0 FP32 rows
qualification.limitation: Timing protocol qualification does not establish all-step correctness or full-model accuracy.

sink_fresh_minus_reuse.interpretation: Within the same shared-sink attention graph, measured preparation-path reduction. Pinned-buffer reuse and invariant Q4 handling are combined; their individual effects are not isolated.

legacy_fresh_minus_reuse.interpretation: Within the same legacy graph and true host updates, the equivalent reusable-table preparation control.

reused_legacy_minus_sink.interpretation: Comparison after optimizing preparation on both paths. It still mixes host updates, planning, different attention kernels and length transport; no end-to-end or independent-novelty attribution.

runner_scope: isolated attention chain, four paired preparation controls; not full model/serving
runner_endpoint: current host descriptor fill + required H2D + shared plan or 16 true FIA updates + replay + final join

timing_boundaries.wall_us: Host preparation, required transfers, planning/host updates, replay and final completion.
timing_boundaries.preparation_enqueue_us: Host construction and enqueue interval; not completed H2D copy duration.
timing_boundaries.queue_span_us: External-event queue span includes submission gaps and waits; not pure kernel duration.
timing_boundaries.submit_join_cpu_us: Host submission interval overlaps queue work; do not add it to queue duration.
timing_boundaries.case_order: Declared case ordering is checked against recorded samples. The rotation strategy shifts odd-trial-reversed case order by (step + trial) modulo four on every step.

assumptions: Fresh/reuse cases for one backend use the same captured graph and private sixteen-occurrence Q/K/V.
Reuse refreshes current KV lengths and owner-page mappings inside the timed endpoint.
Q4 query endpoints are invariant for each default bucket; no dynamic KV length is frozen.
Pinned-buffer lifetime extends through the final completion fence before host storage is overwritten.
Legacy cases retain all real host-length graph updates and final dependency joins.
limitation: Ordinary preparation reuse and invariant-data handling are engineering controls. This experiment cannot establish a new scheduling algorithm or a full-model performance gain.

evidence_projection.regeneration: canonical trace/selection artifacts and stage-four trace helper
